text:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: latency.p95(/v1/generate) > 2.0s in us-west for last 5m. routing_reroute_count=528; fallback_attempts=72. Paging oncall.
alice: @raj paging you — p95 spike and huge reroute churn. can you pick up?
raj: ack, oncall here. joining. what's the current impact window?
maya: seeing flipping between variants: primary -> gpt-open-16q-long -> gpt-open-16fp. the quantized long variant is getting picked by fallback policy and has worse tail on >2k tokens. reroute cooldown looks disabled.
infra-sre: logs show repeated policy decisions around the same requests. excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T18:02:03Z policy_eval route=/v1/generate p95=2.1 reroute=true target=gpt-open-16q-long
2026-03-15T18:02:10Z policy_eval route=/v1/generate p95=1.6 reroute=false
2026-03-15T18:02:18Z policy_eval route=/v1/generate p95=2.3 reroute=true target=gpt-open-16q-long
... (repeated)
```
infra-sre: also seeing region-fallback attempts from us-west -> eu-west when reroute fails; eu-west then rejects some sessions due to auth mismatch (504s).
carla: looks like routing-policy reverted to a commit that removed cooldown/hysteresis flags. recent change: config commit c7d2b1 (rolled 2h ago).
alice: @carla can you confirm that commit? if so we should rollback to c5a9f4 to restore 60s cooldown.
carla: confirmed. c7d2b1 removed `reroute.cooldown_ms` inadvertently. prepared rollback PR: `revert/cooldown-restore`.
raj: mitigation plan:
- pin route /v1/generate to stable variant gpt-open-16fp immediately
- rollback routing-policy to c5a9f4
- disable cross-region fallback for us-west until we validate
- add emergency hysteresis to 120s
I'll apply pin now.
raj: `rwctl routing pin --route /v1/generate --model gpt-open-16fp --reason "emergency pin during reroute thrash"`
sre-bot: deploy pipeline kicked for `revert/cooldown-restore` (CI passed). deploying to control-plane.
sre-bot: control-plane deploy succeeded: rollout v2026.03.15.2 -> routing-policy updated.
maya: seeing reroute_count drop to single digits over last 1m. p95 trending back down to ~0.9s.
eva: customer-impact summary: about 8% of production traffic in us-west experienced p95 > 2s between 18:00-18:06 UTC. ~1200 requests experienced timeouts (504) from region fallback. Major UX degradation for a subset of long-context customers. no data exfiltration.
alice: can you draft a short bridge note for support + a high-level line for sales? we should mention rollback + pin and ETA for full fix.
eva: support note drafted: "We observed elevated latency and intermittent timeouts for some customers in US-West due to routing policy oscillation. We rolled back the routing policy and pinned the primary model. Full RCA and timeline forthcoming." will post to #support-ops.
raj: marking incident as mitigated. keeping channel open for verification and postmortem.
carla: follow-ups:
- add integration test for `reroute.cooldown_ms` enforced in CI
- add unit that validates model-variant latency profiles before policy can route to quantized-long variants
- update runbook to include metric `routing.reroute_count`throttle thresholds
alice: assigning owners and creating incident ticket I-2026-042. ETA for RCA doc EOD tomorrow.
pagerduty-bot: Incident severity: Sev2 -> acknowledged. duration 00:12:31. paging cleared.
raj: closing here, will handoff to cleanup on next shift. :white_check_mark:
